svg.title: Larson–Le’s dual: all circuit planes and six IM extensions
svg.desc: Spatial incidence schematic. Shaded sheets are rank-three flats. The explicitly curved sheet is not an ordinary Euclidean plane.

g.text: D = N* with its six Ingleton–Main extensions
Rank 4 · 10 original elements · 6 added points · all 12 nontrivial planes
the three lines together have rank 4.
Circuits of D: 20 of size 4; 140 of size 5.
4-element circuits: all four-element subsets of a plane A–L. 5-element circuits: all five-element subsets containing none of these 4-circuits.
Filled points 1–10 are original; open colored points 11–16 are IM additions. Unmarked crossings are not elements.
Only L = {6,7,8,10} and the line 7–14–10 are curved. The curved sheet encodes an abstract plane, not Euclidean coplanarity.
The extensions are shown only through their selected forced incidences; this diagram does not choose integral matroid completions.
